name: Kevin Follonier - MR SHIFT 🦁
zh_summary: @KevinWSHPod 的貼文（由 @RaoulGMI 轉發）總結一段訪談：Raoul Pal 表示過去一年只在大幅回調時買入兩次，並新增 $ZEC 持倉。儘管他買入的 $SUI 持倉估計平均成本約 1.70 美元而處於虧損，他仍維持信心，並預期加密與科技將出現延續至 2030 年的超級週期，但期間仍可能有大幅回調。
en_summary: @KevinWSHPod, in a post reposted by @RaoulGMI, summarizes an interview in which Raoul Pal says he has made just two purchases in the past year during major corrections and added a $ZEC position. He keeps conviction in $SUI despite his bought holdings being underwater at an estimated average entry of about $1.70, and expects a crypto and tech supercycle toward 2030 with severe corrections still possible.
text:
Raoul Pal on the Four-Year Window to Build Wealth, the Future of Crypto, and Why AI Changes Everything

In this episode of When Shift Happens, I sit down with @RaoulGMI, co-founder and CEO of @RealVision and founder of Global Macro Investor, for our sixth conversation to discuss the future of crypto, the accelerating impact of artificial intelligence, and why he believes the next four years could fundamentally reshape the global economy. We revisit his investment predictions, examine the thinking behind his controversial $SUI position, and explore what decades of navigating financial markets have taught him about conviction, patience, and building wealth. For Raoul, the opportunity ahead is extraordinary, but so are the consequences of getting left behind.

Why Doing Less Has Become Raoul's Investment Strategy

When we first spoke more than two years ago, Raoul was anticipating the arrival of the "Banana Zone," a period of explosive crypto price appreciation driven by expanding liquidity. That rally never materialized as he expected, but his underlying investment philosophy has barely changed.

Over the past year, Raoul has made just two purchases during significant market corrections, alongside adding a position in $ZEC. Rather than actively trading market cycles, he focuses on accumulating assets he believes will appreciate over longer periods. name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay 表示，黃仁勳指一座 1 GW 的 AI 工廠成本約 500 億美元，每年可帶來約 400 億美元收入，因此部署每延遲一個月就損失約 33 億美元潛在收入。他認為這說明瞭 $NVDA 新 DSX POD 的意義：把部署時間由四個月縮短至約一個月，可在不增加 GPU 的情況下，每 GW 提前帶來逾 100 億美元收入。
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay says Jensen Huang noted a 1 GW AI factory costs about $50B but could generate about $40B in annual revenue, so each month of deployment delay costs about $3.3B in potential revenue. He says this puts the new $NVDA DSX POD in perspective, since cutting deployment from four months to about one could bring forward over $10B of revenue per GW without extra GPUs.
text:
Jensen Huang says a 1 GW AI factory costs ~$50B but could generate ~$40B in annual revenue meaning every month of deployment delays ~$3.3B in potential revenue.

That puts $NVDA new DSX POD into perspective because cutting deployment from 4 months to roughly one month could bring forward over $10B in revenue per GW without needing additional GPUs.

name: The Wolf Of All Streets
zh_summary: @scottmelker 報導，Zcash（$ZEC）開發者把 NU7 升級目標定在 11 月 5 日，將出塊時間由 75 秒縮短至 25 秒。
en_summary: @scottmelker reports that Zcash ($ZEC) developers are targeting Nov. 5 for the NU7 upgrade, which cuts block times from 75 to 25 seconds.

name: Shay Boloor
zh_summary: @StockSavvyShay：$NVDA與$AMKR計劃到2028年將先進封裝產能擴大逾300%，其他夥伴目標將光學引擎產能提升15倍；Nvidia並預付11億美元確保晶片測試產能，黃仁勳稱需求非常強勁。
en_summary: @StockSavvyShay: $NVDA and $AMKR plan to expand advanced packaging capacity by over 300% by 2028, partners target 15x more optical engine capacity, and Nvidia is putting $1.1B upfront for chip testing capacity as Jensen Huang calls demand extraordinary.
text:
$NVDA & $AMKR are planning to expand advanced packaging capacity by over 300% by 2028 while Nvidia's other partners target 15x more optical-engine capacity.

Nvidia is also putting $1.1B upfront to secure additional chip testing capacity as Jensen Huang says "demand is extraordinary."
